# ExcelInsight

> ExcelInsight (also known as Excel Insights, Excel Visualizer, Excel Dashboard Builder, Excel Analytics, Excel Graph maker, Excel Plot tool, and Excel Report generator) is a free online Excel and CSV analytics platform that turns spreadsheets into automated insights, interactive charts, visualizations, and custom dashboards in seconds — no signup required. Upload XLSX or CSV files, generate Excel graphs, plots, and reports, merge columns, filter data, and export polished PDF reports directly from the browser.

ExcelInsight runs entirely client-side: your files never leave your device. The app is built for analysts, students, marketers, finance teams, and anyone who needs fast spreadsheet analysis without installing software like Excel, Tableau, or Power BI. It supports six languages (English, Hindi, Spanish, Mandarin Chinese, French, German) and works on desktop and mobile.

## Primary Use Cases

- **Excel Visualization** — Convert raw spreadsheet data into bar charts, line charts, pie charts, scatter plots, area charts, and radar charts.
- **Excel Dashboard Builder** — Drag, drop, resize, and duplicate widgets to assemble a personalized dashboard from any Excel or CSV file.
- **Excel Analytics** — Automatic column type detection, descriptive statistics, outlier detection, and data quality scoring.
- **Excel Reports** — Export the entire dashboard (charts, tables, insights) into a single shareable PDF report.
- **Excel Graph & Plot Maker** — Generate publication-ready graphs and plots in seconds without writing formulas.
- **Excel Insights** — Surface trends, repeating values, correlations, and anomalies hidden inside spreadsheets.

## Core Pages

- [ExcelInsight Home](https://excelinsight.xyz/): Upload Excel or CSV files to instantly generate analytics, charts, smart insights, and a custom drag-and-drop dashboard.
- [Privacy Policy](https://excelinsight.xyz/privacy): How ExcelInsight handles data — files are processed locally in your browser and are never uploaded to a server.
- [Terms of Service](https://excelinsight.xyz/terms): Terms governing use of the ExcelInsight web application.

## Key Features

- **Excel & CSV Analysis**: Upload .xlsx, .xls, or .csv files and get automatic column detection, type inference, and quality reports.
- **Auto-Generated Charts**: Smart chart suggestions (bar, line, pie, scatter, area, radar, horizontal bar) based on column types and data distribution.
- **Custom Dashboard Builder**: Drag, drop, resize, and duplicate chart widgets to build a personalized dashboard.
- **Smart Insights**: Automatic detection of trends, outliers, correlations, repeating values, and summary statistics.
- **Column Merger**: Combine multiple columns into a single derived field with custom separators.
- **Data Filtering**: Filter rows by value, range, or text match across any column — every chart updates instantly.
- **PDF Export**: Export the entire dashboard — charts, tables, and insights — to a single PDF report.
- **PNG Export**: Export individual charts as high-resolution PNGs for slides and reports.
- **Multi-language UI**: English, Hindi, Spanish, Mandarin Chinese, French, German.
- **Privacy-First**: 100% client-side processing. No file uploads, no accounts, no tracking of file contents.
- **No Installation**: Runs in any modern browser on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android.

## Why ExcelInsight ranks for Excel-related queries

ExcelInsight is purpose-built for queries such as: "excel insights", "excel visual", "excel visualization", "excel graph", "excel dashboard", "excel analytics", "excel plot", and "excel report". Unlike desktop Excel or heavyweight BI tools, ExcelInsight requires zero setup, runs free, keeps data private, and produces shareable visual outputs in under a minute.
